text: Due to the limited range of quadcopter UAVs, the attacks were on the base almost certainly launched from within the Russian Federation The creation of these volunteer security patrols will likely act as a deterrence and provide a level of defence against quadcopter UAVs being operated from the immediate vicinity of the air base.Historically it has proven difficult to destroy UAVs using small-arms fire, so Russian forces will still require air-defence systems, with a surveillance capability and both kinetic and electronic means of interception, to destroy attacking UAVs The use of volunteers highly likely indicates a shortage of trained security personnel within Russia
